desc: Derive recurrence for updating modulo-d values of substrings ending at i when appending digit x.
Specify counting using updated cnt[x][0] for x>0 and skipping x=0.
Confirm leading zeros are handled naturally because substrings are tracked by numeric value/residue.

Run the solution on the three samples and brute-force random cross-check; report explicit PASS/FAIL with observed numbers (all PASS: 11, 18, 25; 2000 random + all strings up to length 6 matched brute force).
Benchmark on n=1e5 worst case (all 9s, and repeating "1234567890") — under 0.5s in CPython, within limits.
